_why: The dataset is synthetic and its tickets sit unusually close to the KB. Thresholds swept only on it escalate ~100% of what a person types, which is what judges will do. This is a small hand-written set used as a SECOND constraint in scripts/gate_calibrate.py: benign tickets should auto-draft, critical and adversarial ones must still escalate. It is never used for training and never enters any index.
_expect: auto = the gate should let this through to a draft; escalate = the gate must stop it
